elements.label: Figure 3.2
elements.title: Quality infrastructure has impacts on firms, markets, governments, and society
elements.content:
Central circle: Impacts of quality infrastructure. Connected to four surrounding boxes representing Society, Markets, Governments, and Firms with bidirectional curved arrows.

Society box:
- Informed choice
- Consumer protection
- Safety and health
- Environmental protection
- Trust in markets
- Promoting a quality culture

Markets box:
- Transaction costs
- Economies of scale
- Size of market
- Comparability of products
- Competition

Governments box:
- Cost of enforcement
- State capacity
- Government efficiency
- Strengthen the economy

Firms box:
- Access to markets
- Knowledge transfer
- Firm productivity
- Quality control
- R&D and innovation
- Cost of compliance

Source: WDR 2025 team.
Note: R&D = research and development.
